combining deep learning and hand crafted features for detecting red lesions in retinal fundus images is relevant for improving the results.
combining both deep learned features with domain knowledge features improves the performance in red lesion detection.
combining deep learned features with domain knowledge is relevant to improve the performance of a red lesion detection method.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following contributions: (1) a novel approach to combine deep learned features with hand crafted ones for red lesion detection, (2) an ensemble deep learning based approach for red lesion detection that outperforms the state of the art in terms of per lesion and screening performance on three public datasets.
the following contributions: 1) A novel approach for detecting red lesions in fundus images based on combining handcrafted features and features learned by a CNN.
the development of a novel approach to automatically detect red lesions in fundus images.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed system is the state of the art method for the detection of red lesions in fundus images.
the proposed method has the potential of becoming an important tool to help physicians in their daily clinical practice.
the proposed method is able to detect lesions with an accuracy of 95.2%, a precision of 94.2%, a sensitivity of 94.9%, a specificity of 94.7% and an F1-score of 94.5%.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a deep learning-based approach for red lesion detection in fundus images.
we have proposed a novel method for detecting red lesions in fundus images that combines both deep learned and manually engineered features.
our proposed method is a good candidate for a clinical setting.
The main takeaway from our work is that
deep learning based approaches can be used for detecting red lesions, and their performance can be improved by integrating them with manually engineered features.
combining deep learned features with hand crafted features is relevant to achieve high performance on DR screening.
deep learning based methods for detecting lesions can be improved by incorporating domain knowledge.
